This file guides Claude Code (claude.ai/code) for TD Studios’ luxury Next.js 15 website. It is synced with v0.app and deployed on Vercel.

## Stack
- Next.js 15.5.4 App Router; React ^18; TypeScript ^5, strict mode
- Supabase/PostgreSQL; Tailwind CSS v3.4.17/PostCSS; Radix UI/shadcn/ui (New York, RSC)
- pnpm v10.15.1; Geist Sans/Mono; Lucide React
- Vercel Analytics; Vitest/jsdom unit tests; Playwright E2E
- OpenAI ChatKit support chat; Resend contact email
- JWT authentication via `jose`

## Structure
- `app/`: route-based pages; `api/`: API routes
- `contact/`: POST contact endpoint using Resend
- `chatkit/session/`: POST ChatKit session endpoint using OpenAI
- `intake/`: POST lead qualification endpoint using Supabase
- `work/`, `web/`, `dev/`, `social/`, `design/`, `process/`, `faq/`, `book/`, `legal/`, `support/`, `resources/`
- `clients/[client]/`: protected client portals; `[client]/signin/`: sign-in
- `globals.css`, `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`
- `components/`: `sticky-header.tsx`, `nav.tsx`, `footer.tsx`, `glass-card.tsx`, `frosted-button.tsx`, `page-title.tsx`, `section.tsx`, `json-ld.tsx`, `calendly-embed.tsx`, `logo.tsx`, `analytics-provider.tsx`, `ab-test-wrapper.tsx`, `theme-provider.tsx`, `ui/`
- `lib/`: `utils.ts`, `analytics.ts`, `ab-testing.ts`
- `public/`, `styles/`, `tests/`

## Environment Variables
Create `.env.local` in the project root; use `.env.local.example`:
`RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE` (e.g., `CLIENT_THEBODYBOUTIQUE_PASSCODE`).

## Commands
```bash
pnpm dev            # Start development server (Next.js dev mode on port 3000)
pnpm serve          # Start production server on port 3000 (after building)
pnpm build          # Build for production using Next.js
pnpm lint           # Run Next.js linting with ESLint
pnpm typecheck      # Run TypeScript type checking without emitting files
pnpm ci:verify      # Run full CI verification (lint + typecheck + test)
pnpm report:types   # Generate type error report using custom script
pnpm scan:secrets   # Scan entire codebase for potential secrets using secretlint
pnpm scan:secrets:staged  # Scan only staged git files for secrets (used by pre-commit hook)
pnpm test           # Run unit tests with Vitest (single run)
pnpm test:watch     # Run Vitest in watch mode for development
pnpm test:jest      # Run Jest tests (if applicable)
npx playwright test # Run Playwright end-to-end tests
npx playwright test --ui # Run tests with UI mode for debugging
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts # Run specific test file
pnpm lh:routes      # Run Lighthouse audits on routes using custom script
```

## Testing
Vitest uses `vitest.config.ts`, `tests/setup.ts`, `*.spec.ts?(x)`, `@/` aliases, globals, JSX via esbuild, and `passWithNoTests: false`. It excludes `**/mobile-layout.spec.ts` and `**/playwright/**`. Playwright tests in `tests/` cover mobile centering, parallax, touch targets, viewport handling, and text sizing; screenshots are in `tests/screenshots/`. Default Playwright configuration is used. ESLint errors and TypeScript build errors are ignored during builds for deployment compatibility.

## Configuration
- Strict mode, ES2017 target, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitReturns`, `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch`, isolated modules, Next.js app-router plugin.
- `@/*` maps to project root.
- Image domains: `i.imgur.com`, `via.placeholder.com`, `cdn.platform.openai.com`, `tdstudiosny.com`; AVIF/WebP responsive optimization.
- `www.tdstudiosny.com` → `tdstudiosny.com` permanent 301 redirect.

## Design
Luxury, mobile-first dark/light theme with black `oklch(0.145 0 0)` background, white text, OKLCH tokens, neutral palette, 0.625rem default radius, Geist fonts, Lucide icons, Tailwind spacing, accessible semantic HTML/ARIA/keyboard navigation. Glass cards use Neutral-900 at 70% opacity, backdrop blur, and borders. FrostedButton supports Link/button polymorphism, variants, focus/hover transitions, and analytics. `layout.tsx` includes StickyHeader, Footer, analytics, and inline iOS Safari viewport/background fixes.

## Analytics/A-B Testing
Track page views, button clicks with location, form success/errors, downloads, bookings, scroll depth, time on page, CTA position, and conversions. A/B tests support structured definitions, variant control, percentage traffic allocation, enable/disable management, and analytics integration.

## APIs
- Contact: form name/email/message; Resend success/error delivery response.
- ChatKit: OpenAI session creation/continuation; returns token/configuration.
- Intake: Supabase lead data; returns lead ID/qualification status and stores qualified leads.

## Authentication
JWT tokens are signed/verified with `jose` and `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters required). Each client uses `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`. `/[client]/signin` authenticates; `/clients/[client]` requires valid JWT. Token sessions protect client data.

## Workflow/Security
Auto-sync is v0.app → GitHub → Vercel. Major changes should use v0.app; consider sync implications for manual edits. Project: https://v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7. Use `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Husky hooks install automatically via postinstall. Pre-commit scans staged files. Pre-push enforces feature branches and scans secrets:

```bash
if ! git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | xargs -I{} -r secretlint "{}"; then
echo "🚫 Secretlint found potential secrets in staged files."
branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
[ "$branch" = "main" ] && { echo "🚫 Direct pushes to main are blocked. Use feature branch + PR."; exit 1; }
if [ -z "$CI" ]; then
pnpm -s scan:secrets >/dev/null || { echo "🚫 Pre-push secret scan failed."; exit 1; }
```

Secretlint uses `<REDACTED_USER>/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend`. All changes to main must go through PRs.

## Routes
`/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`. Primary nav: WORK · WEB · DEV · SOCIAL · DESIGN · PROCESS · RESOURCES · FAQ · CONTACT. Footer: Support · Legal · Book. All pages include canonical, OpenGraph, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD metadata. `/pricing` merged into `/faq`; `/services` split into `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`.

See `ROUTES.md` and `docs/architecture-map.json` for routing and infrastructure documentation.
